correctness.rationale: Use exact vertex model signed permutations of (r,1,1), r=1+sqrt2: 24 vertices and 48 shortest distance-2 edges. For a generic central plane, each section vertex is exactly one sign-changing original edge. Signed-permutation chamber normals sorted a>b>c>0; signs of A=a-rb-c,B=a-rb+c,C=a-b-rc,H=a+b-rc obey A<B,A<C,B<H,C<H, admitting exactly six strict sign patterns (diamond partial order), with all crossing numbers 8 for A>0 and 12 otherwise. This reduces continuum to exhaustive finite chambers. Edge dot=(3+2sqrt2) and squared vertex norm=(5+2sqrt2); each edge angle theta=acos((7+4sqrt2)/17). Haar separation probability for each edge theta/pi hence E N=48 theta/pi; with two-point support, P8=3-12theta/pi and P12=12theta/pi-2. Independent standalone vertex/edge reconstruction and 18000 random normals found 3809 octagonal,14191 dodecagonal, with exact sorted-coordinate criterion in every sample. Samples corroborate, finite algebraic sign table and Haar integral prove all generic directions.
